stem: Pointing to a boy, Riya said, "He is the son of my mother's only son." Riya is a woman. How is the boy related to Riya?
explanation: Riya is a woman, so her mother's only son is Riya's brother. The boy is her brother's son, i.e., her nephew.

stem: A, B, C and D are four different persons. A is the brother of B. B is the sister of C. C is the father of D. How is A related to D?
explanation: A and C are both siblings of B, so A is C's brother. C is D's father, so A, being male, is D's paternal uncle.

stem: Introducing a woman, Arjun said, "Her father is the only son of my father's father." How is the woman related to Arjun?
explanation: Arjun's father's father is his paternal grandfather, and that man's only son is Arjun's father. So the woman's father is Arjun's father, which makes her Arjun's sister.
shortcut: Resolve the phrase from the speaker's end

explanation: A + B: A is B's father. B × C: B is C's brother, so A is also C's father. C − D: C is D's wife. Hence A is the father of D's wife, i.e., D's father-in-law.
shortcut: Decode one symbol at a time, left to right

explanation: P @ Q: P is Q's sister. Q $ R: Q is R's mother. R # S: R is S's son, and since S is not Q, S is R's father, i.e., Q's husband. S is the husband of P's sister, so S is P's brother-in-law.

stem: Pointing to a lady in a photograph, Vikram said, "She is the only daughter of the mother-in-law of my wife's only brother." How is the lady related to Vikram's wife?
explanation: Vikram's wife's only brother — call him K. K's mother-in-law is the mother of K's wife, and her only daughter is K's wife. So the lady is the wife of Vikram's wife's brother, i.e., her sister-in-law.
shortcut: Work backwards from the last relation named

stem: A, B, C, D and E are five different persons. A is the son of B. C is the mother of B. D is the only son of C and is married to E. How is D related to A?
explanation: B is C's child. If B were male, B would be C's only son, i.e., D — but B and D are different persons. So B is C's daughter and D is B's brother. B is A's mother, so D is A's maternal uncle.
shortcut: Use 'only son' to fix the gender of B

stem: Pointing to a man, Anita says, "His mother is the only daughter of my mother." How is the man related to Anita?
explanation: The only daughter of Anita's mother is Anita herself. So the man's mother is Anita, which makes him Anita's son.
shortcut: "Only daughter of my mother" = the speaker (if female)
